name: Santa Girls
source:
A Christmas themed adult romance visual novel, following a male protagonist as he takes a job managing Santa's female helpers in Paradise Cove's new super market. Will you be able to make the Christmas event a success and possibly find love along the way, your decision will determine the games outcome, with a large variety of choices to make that will change the games events and final ending.

The game features four female characters to get to know whilst working.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/467710/]Steam[/url]]
